review_candidates.title: M365 Trainer
review_candidates.description: UK (Remote) Permanent | Full Time The Role We’re looking for an M365 Trainer who gets genuinely excited about helping people unlock the potential of Microsoft technology and AI. Someone who can walk into a room, capture attention and leave people feeling inspired, confident and ready to put what they’ve learned into practice. You’ll deliver engaging training across Microsoft 365, Copilot, AI and Power Platform, helping people build the skills and confidence they need to embrace new ways of working. For us, great training isn’t about reading from slides or simply showing people where to click. It’s about bringing technology to life, making it relevant to the person in front of you and helping them understand how it can genuinely make a difference to the way they work. What You’ll Be Doing Training Delivery Deliver engaging, end-to-end Microsoft 365 and Power Platform training, making sure every session is relevant to the audience and their needs. Deliver training across Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, Agent Builder and Power Platform, including Power Apps, Power Automate and Copilot Studio. Bring your knowledge of Modern Work applications such as Teams, Loop and SharePoint into your sessions, helping people understand how the wider Microsoft ecosystem comes together. Deliver virtual training, adapting your style to different audiences, levels of confidence and learning needs. Create sessions where people feel comfortable asking questions, getting involved and putting what they’re learning into practice. Content Creation Create and keep training materials, presentations, guides and learning resources engaging, useful and up to date. Develop content across Microsoft 365 and Power Platform, including Copilot, Copilot Chat, AI, Agents, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Power Apps and Power Automate. Work with our internal teams to tailor training to our customers and their requirements, including areas such as governance and responsible AI. Look for ways to continuously improve our content and the overall learning experience. Product Knowledge Keep your Microsoft knowledge fresh, staying on top of new features and functionality across Microsoft 365, Copilot and Power Platform. Help people see how technology fits into their day-to-day work, using practical examples that make it relevant and useful. Bring areas such as AI-enabled working and low-code automation to life through relatable, everyday scenarios. Help customers build confidence with new tools and turn learning into real-world adoption. User Support & Feedback Be there to support users with questions following training and help them overcome challenges. Listen to feedback from participants and use it to make future sessions even better. Change & Adoption Support wider change and adoption activity around Microsoft 365, Copilot and Power Platform rollouts. Help people understand best practice, including areas such as responsible AI, governance and data security. Make these topics easy to understand and relevant to how people actually use the technology. Essential What We’re Looking For Proven experience delivering Microsoft 365 training in a client-facing environment. Confidence delivering training across Power Platform, particularly Power Apps and Power Automate. Experience running interactive workshops or hackathon-style sessions. A confident communicator and presenter, both virtually and in person. The ability to take complex or technical concepts and make them simple, engaging and relevant. Comfortable working with different stakeholders, organisations and audiences. Able to adapt quickly and comfortable working in a fast-moving environment. A genuine enjoyment of helping people learn and build confidence with technology. Desirable Experience delivering Copilot or AI-focused training. Experience working within a Microsoft Partner or consultancy environment. Experience supporting adoption or change-led transformation programmes. We're not expecting you to know absolutely everything. Microsoft technology moves quickly, and so do we. Curiosity, credibility and the ability to connect with people and help them learn are just as important to us. What You’ll Get In Return Competitive salary, dependent on experience. 25 days’ annual leave, plus public holidays, with an additional day for each year of service, up to 5 extra days. Christmas shutdown, giving you time to switch off, recharge and spend time with loved ones. Health & wellbeing support, including a Health Cash Plan, mental wellbeing support, gym discounts and confidential support through our Employee Assistance Programme. Pension scheme, with a 3% employer contribution. Perks and discounts through Bravo Perks and Bravo Hub. Salary sacrifice options, including cycle-to-work and technology purchase schemes. Paid Microsoft training and certifications, subject to the relevant conditions. Learning and development opportunities, including access to leadership development programmes and plenty of opportunities to continue developing your skills. Flexible, trust-based working, giving you flexibility around where you work while balancing customer and business needs. If you love training, enjoy bringing technology to life and want to help people feel more confident using Microsoft and AI, we’d love to hear from you.
